placements.title: Autonomous slug generation and deterministic fallback guarantee ingestion persistence without explicit IDs
placements.frame: How does the ingestion pipeline guarantee successful file commitment when incoming submissions omit an explicit identifier?
placements.why: Segments src-1 and src-2 establish that when submissions lack an explicit ID, the ingestion pipeline must synthesize a slug through LLM generation or deterministic fallback to reliably commit the artifact.
